answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Each attestation is a thread tied to a bonded identity, so a false claim can be traced back to its owner. Like a glacier, trust builds slowly and steadily. New identities climb a terrace of reviews before their votes carry weight.
